contracts: (Replay is accepted only when fresh-checkout canonical result and all result-determining snapshot inputs match the recorded result.) AND (Validation proves the result references a complete Current Snapshot and rejects absent or partial bindings.) AND (两类受支持路由均可达并返回成功，且每个结果含 effective inspected content 标识。)
selector_intents: Replay a result artifact with the Current Snapshot removed or truncated; validation must fail closed and identify incomplete binding.
Run replay from a clean checkout with a deliberately missing or altered snapshot input; the reproducibility check must fail deterministically.
运行 VDD/Acceptance 路由 smoke 并禁用一个受支持路由；若 smoke 仍成功则失败。
